narration: What if your day had twenty five hours? Meet Chronos Labs, a time technology company on Meme Street's fictional market. Step inside one of its chambers, and an hour passes for you, while only a minute passes outside. It's the extra hour, sold by the day. It hires chambers out to companies by the day, sells slower, pricier pods for the home, and charges for service plans, because every pod needs regular recalibrating. Doctors catch up on notes, students revise, and engineers finish designs. The economy gets more done per day, without anyone working a longer one. Its edge is that nobody else can keep a time field stable. That's why the waitlists are long. The risks? Safety recalls, huge energy bills, and a fierce ethics debate. On Meme Street, stories like these hit the news wire, and the price reacts. Find Chronos Labs, and trade time itself, at memestreet.net.
